headline: Crude Oil Falls 1.46 Percent To $101.28 As Money Leaves The Energy Pipe
narrative: Crude oil fell 1.46 percent to $101.28, with money leaving the energy pipe. Copper rose 0.27 percent to $6.66 and the S&P 500 rose 0.28 percent to 7,743.98, an industrial and equity bid that moved apart from oil. Gold rose 0.09 percent to $4,055.1 while Bitcoin changed hands near 80k, so the precious-metals and crypto pipes stood apart from the energy sale.
author: jordan
